description: This file declares functions related to cryptographic signing within the confui namespace, including test signing and secure environment signing, involving optional return types and byte vector parameters.

methods.name: TestSign
methods.description: Performs a test signing operation on the provided message using a local test key, returning an optional byte vector with the signature.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Performs a signing operation on the provided message using secure_env, returning an optional byte vector with the signature.
